SessionStart.description: Load durable context: previous session summary, newest checkpoint, captured lessons, git state and the project's package manager.

SessionEnd.description: Persist the branch, last commit and outstanding instructions, then mine the session for durable lessons.

PreCompact.description: Write a handoff note to .claude/state before context is discarded, so repo facts survive compaction.

PostToolUse.description: Suggest compacting at a natural seam once the session has run long, instead of waiting for an indiscriminate automatic compaction.
